name: Valid query returns expected response format
description: A normal query must return HTTP 200 with a JSON results list whose items contain an id or name field. Otherwise an invalid response is recorded.

name: Empty query
description: An empty query should be rejected with a validation response.

name: Missing query field
description: A request without the query field should be rejected with a validation response.

name: Invalid JSON body
description: A malformed JSON body should produce a client error (4xx), not a server error.

name: Very long query (10,000 characters)
description: A very long query must be handled gracefully: a valid response or a clean client error, never a 5xx, timeout or dropped connection.

name: Unknown path on the participant server
description: A request to a path that does not exist should return 404 or 405.

name: Duplicate query consistency
description: Sending the same query several times must return valid responses with identical result IDs each time.
